```tok
pool sport "Sports Institute" {
  lane user "User" {
    start start "Start"
    task select-course "select a course"
    task select-one "select one"
    task log-into "log into it"
    task complete-registration "complete registration and provide payment information"
    end end "End"
  }

  lane system "System" {
    task tell-courses "system tells courses and dates"
    task check-account "check if you already have an account"
    task check-eligibility "check whether you are registered at an eligible university"
    task register-account "register your account"
    task request-activation "request an activation and wait for a response"
    task tweet-friends "tweet to friends"
    task send-ticket "receive a course ticket"
  }
}

/* Gateways */
xor g1 "Slots free?"
xor g2 "Account exists?"
xor g3 "Eligible university?"
and p1 "Parallel activities"
and p2 "Parallel join"

/* Flows */
flow start -> select-course
flow select-course -> g1
flow g1 -> tell-courses when="slotsFree"
flow g1 -> end default

flow tell-courses -> select-one
flow select-one -> check-account
flow check-account -> g2
flow g2 -> log-into when="accountExists"
flow g2 -> check-eligibility default

flow check-eligibility -> g3
flow g3 -> register-account when="eligible"
flow g3 -> request-activation default

flow register-account -> log-into
flow request-activation -> log-into

flow log-into -> p1
flow p1 -> tweet-friends
flow p1 -> complete-registration

flow tweet-friends -> p2
flow complete-registration -> p2

flow p2 -> send-ticket
flow send-ticket -> end
```
